Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing regulation of water recreation facilities.

BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature no longer finds it necessaryto regulate water recreation facilities in the state of Washington.
